item.title: West Plains Christmas Assistance Program Sees 20th Year Amid Financial Difficulty - Ozark Radio News
item.description: With difficulties in funding presenting themselves, one Christmas Program was in danger of ending after nearly 20 years. However, with the help of the local community, it will continue for another round.

item.title: West Plains Optimist Club Arts and Crafts Show December 6th and 7th - Ozark Radio News
item.description: The West Plains Optimist Club is hosting its 43rd annual arts and crafts show at the West Plains Civic Center on December 6th and 7th. Saturday will run from 8:30-5 and Sunday from 10-3. Discover unique handcrafted gifts, support local artisans, and find the perfect presents for everyone on your holiday list.

item.title: Mountain View Woman Injured in One Vehicle Accident - Ozark Radio News
item.description: On Friday a 60-year-old Mountain View woman sustained minor injuries on W Highway one mile west of White Church. The accident occurred when she ran off the right side of Highway W and struck a fence in a 2020 Ford Explorer. She was taken to Ozarks Healthcare in West Plains for treatment by private vehicle.

item.title: Licking Lighting of the Mill Rescheduled - Ozark Radio News

item.title: Due to Weather Go Farm Farmers Market Closed Today Saturday 11/29 - Ozark Radio News
